sourceCopy.name: PDF Metadata Editor
sourceCopy.title: PDF Metadata Editor Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Edit standard PDF title, author, subject and dates free in your browser. No upload; keep the original PDF unchanged.
sourceCopy.intro: Read or edit common document information stored in a PDF, then download a separate copy. The selected PDF stays on this device.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: Which PDF metadata can I change?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: This tool edits the standard document information fields: title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, creation date and modification date. It does not edit XMP metadata or custom properties.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Reading and editing happen in your browser after you choose a file. The original file is not changed; saving creates a separate PDF copy.

fields.warning: Keep your original. Re-saving may invalidate digital signatures or affect advanced PDF features. This tool does not remove hidden information or certify privacy.

fields.sourceNote: Processing is local in this browser. No account, upload, server processing or automatic saving.
fields.clearHint: Leave a field blank to remove that standard information entry from the new copy. Other fields are kept.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this remove all metadata from a PDF?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It edits only common entries in the standard PDF document information dictionary. XMP, custom properties, embedded files and other hidden content may remain.

additionalFaqs.question: Will editing metadata preserve a digital signature?
additionalFaqs.answer: Do not rely on that. Saving rewrites the PDF and can invalidate existing digital signatures or affect features not supported by this tool. Keep the original and verify the copy.

additionalFaqs.question: Is the original PDF overwritten?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. The tool reads the selected file and creates a separate downloadable copy. It does not modify the original on your device.
